facts.text: For over 40 years, Muskingum University's PLUS Program has provided dedicated support to help students with learning differences grow their skills, gain confidence, and thrive in college.

sources.title: Muskingum Plus Program | Muskingum University
sources.quote: At Muskingum, the PLUS Program is here to support you. For over 40 years, we've helped students with learning differences grow their skills, gain confidence, and thrive in college.
